## Sentaku

![](../../assets/playable/inomissing/abilities/woshu_sentaku.png){ .entry-move-icon loading=lazy } *Active*

The user grabs the one in front of them and washes them like laundry. Once washed through they come out flat and limp like cloth, they cant hit, cant use abilities and move slowly. Armament Haki makes it last half as long

## Tenpiboshi

![](../../assets/playable/inomissing/abilities/woshu_tenpiboshi.png){ .entry-move-icon loading=lazy } *Active*

The user hangs the one in front of them out to dry on a clothesline. They stay stuck in the air until the time is out or the line breaks, every hit on the line wears it out, theirs too. Laundry stays hung longer. Armament Haki makes it last half as long One body on the line. A long line, up to 3 bodies in front of the user at once, for half the time.
